title: Delightful Policy Gradient under Distributed Friction
abstract: arXiv:2603.20521v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distributed reinforcement learning trains on data from stale, buggy, or mismatched actors, whose actions often have high surprisal (negative log-probability) under the learner's policy. Supervised fine-tuning learns stably from such logged data, while policy gradient often does not. We trace the difference to negative learning from surprising data: rare failures can dominate finite-batch updates, while rare successes carry information the current policy would otherwise miss. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) separates the two by gating each term with delight, the product of advantage and surprisal, and needs no behavior probabilities. In a contaminated bandit, DG suppresses the perpendicular noise of rare failures by a factor that vanishes as the learner improves; no gate based only on learner probability can do this without also suppressing rare successes. translated_title: 分布式摩擦下的愉悦策略梯度
translated_abstract: 分布式强化学习的训练数据来自过时、有缺陷或策略不匹配的执行器，这些执行器的动作在学习者策略下往往具有高惊讶度（即负对数概率）。监督微调能够从这类记录数据中稳定学习，而策略梯度方法通常不能。我们将这种差异追溯到来自惊讶数据的负学习效应：罕见的失败可能主导有限批次的更新，而罕见的成功则携带着当前策略本会错过的信息。愉悦策略梯度通过用“惊喜”（delight，即优势与惊讶度的乘积）对每一项进行门控来区分这两者，且无需行为概率。在一个受污染的老虎机问题中，DG 以一个随学习者能力提升而趋于消失的因子来抑制罕见失败的垂直噪声；任何仅基于学习者概率的门控都无法在不抑制罕见成功的情况下做到这一点。在带有过时执行器的 MNIST 任务上，DG 优于重要性加权的策略梯度方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出愉悦策略梯度（DG），通过用优势与惊讶度的乘积作为门控信号，在不依赖行为概率的情况下抑制分布式强化学习中罕见失败带来的噪声，同时保留罕见成功所携带的关键信息。
en_tdlr: The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) gates each update term by "delight"—the product of advantage and surprisal—suppressing noise from rare failures in distributed reinforcement learning without requiring behavior probabilities, while preserving the information carried by rare successes.
